description: The bar chart titled "Recall@10" illustrates the recall rates for different methods of conversation recommendation. The vertical axis represents the recall rate, ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, while the horizontal axis lists three methods: "Critiquing," "Scoring," and "Ranking." The "Critiquing" method has the highest recall rate, approximately 0.35, represented by an orange bar. The "Scoring" method has a recall rate of about 0.3, shown by a blue bar. The "Ranking" method has the lowest recall rate, around 0.2, depicted by a grey bar. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
